summary.en: intentfirst.ai is a design-language framework, Context Grammar, giving AI systems the vocabulary to understand intent, not just input. Defines 8 Context Tokens and a 3-layer memory model, demonstrated across three applied projects.
summary.jp: Context Grammar という設計言語で、AIに「入力」ではなく「意図」を読む語彙を与える。8つのContext Tokenと3層の記憶モデルを定義し、3つの実プロジェクトで検証した。

thesis.en: AI knows what you asked. It doesn't know what you need. A shared vocabulary for context can let AI understand what a person actually needs in the moment.
thesis.jp: AIは何を頼まれたかは分かるが、何が必要かは分からない。状況を表す共通の語彙があれば、それが伝わる。

experiment.en: Defined Context Grammar: 8 structured Context Tokens plus a 3-layer memory model, demonstrated across 3 applied projects — The Living Home, The Family Trip, Fluid Handoff.
experiment.jp: Context Grammarを定義した。8つのContext Tokenと3層の記憶モデルを、3つの実プロジェクトで実装し検証した。

question.en: Can a structured vocabulary for a user's physical state, cognitive load and autonomy preference give AI/OS platforms a practical way to design for intent, not literal input?
question.jp: 身体状態や認知負荷、自律性の好みを表す語彙は、AIが入力でなく意図に沿って動く助けになるか。

mine: Defined the Context Grammar framework: 8 structured Context Tokens describing who a user is in the moment, not just what they said
Designed the 3-layer memory model — Identity, Accumulated Learning, Right Now
Built 3 applied demonstration projects: The Living Home, The Family Trip, Fluid Handoff
Published the framework and site at intentfirst.ai

label.en: Context Tokens defining a user's state
label.jp: 利用者の状態を示す項目

label.en: memory layers — Identity, Accumulated Learning, Right Now
